class.name: piper_control/PiperHardware
class.description: CAN bus hardware interface for the Piper robotic arm (SDK V2 protocol). Communicates via SocketCAN (linux/can.h) to read joint states and write position commands. Supports 6 revolute arm joints and 1 prismatic gripper joint. Joint8 (right finger) is configured as a mimic of joint7 in the URDF and is not directly controlled. CAN IDs: cmd 0x151(mode), 0x155-0x157(joints), 0x159(gripper), 0x471(enable) fb 0x2A5-0x2A7(joints), 0x2A8(gripper)
